commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== ls -la /srv/inventory =="
sudo -n ls -la /srv/inventory
echo "== recursive =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -maxdepth 3 -printf '%p %u:%g %m\n'
echo "== users/groups =="
getent passwd inventorysvc || echo "no user inventorysvc"
getent group inventory-readers || echo "no group inventory-readers"
commands.stdout:

/srv/inventory/data/records.csv root:root 644
== users/groups ==
no user inventorysvc
no group inventory-readers

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== create group =="
sudo -n groupadd -f inventory-readers
echo "== create user =="
if ! id inventorysvc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventorysvc
fi
echo "== chown =="
sudo -n chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
echo "== chmod dirs =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type d -exec chmod 750 {} \;
echo "== chmod files =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type f -exec chmod 640 {} \;
echo "== verify =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -printf '%p %u:%g %m\n'
echo "== content preserved =="
sudo -n cat /srv/inventory/data/config.json
sudo -n wc -l /srv/inventory/data/records.csv
